hero.sub: Jacquard canvas with the Uroko pattern, soft structure that follows the shape of the head. The SAINT cap opens the house, one piece at a time.

story.p1: SAINT was born of a clear intention: to take the time to design pieces that mean something, free from the constant acceleration of trends. We see accessories not as add-ons, but as objects of expression in their own right.
story.p2: Inspired by the clean lines of contemporary design and the rigour of Japanese aesthetics, our approach favours the relief of the material, the precision of the cut and an uncompromising attention to detail. From the jacquard weave to the adjuster strap, every element is designed to stand the test of time and blend naturally into everyday dress.
story.p3: Create with intention, build with patience, give weight to what lasts.

uroko.label: The pattern
uroko.title: Uroko, the scale that protects
uroko.p1: In traditional Japanese textiles, the Uroko pattern dressed armour and kimonos as a symbol of protection and renewal. SAINT translates it into woven jacquard, tone on tone, straight into the cap's canvas, so it only reveals itself to a lingering eye.
uroko.p2: The pattern also draws on seigaiha, the ancestral Japanese wave motif symbolising calm and good fortune, and on the shape of the SAINT fan, found engraved on every medallion.

turntable.label: The detail
turntable.p: The back adjuster strap, mounted at a precise angle for a clean, wrinkle-free fit, signs every Éventail cap.
turntable.caption: SAINT — Éventail Edition

care_panel.intro: To preserve the jacquard canvas over time:
care_panel.item1: Hand wash only, gently, in lukewarm or cold water.
care_panel.item2: Mild or natural soap, applied gently with a soft cloth or a soft-bristle brush.
care_panel.item3: Never machine wash, tumble dry, or wring mechanically.
care_panel.item4: Dry flat or over a rounded form, in open air, away from direct sunlight to avoid any discolouration.

faq.a1: Each piece is crafted with particular care, in small series, from materials chosen for how they hold up over time.
faq.a2: Yes. Each series is produced in a deliberately restricted quantity, to preserve its exceptional character.

faq.a4: You have 14 days from receipt to return an intact item, tags attached, in its original packaging. Contact our customer service to start the process.
faq.q5: How do I care for my cap?
faq.a5: Hand wash only, gently, in lukewarm or cold water, with a mild soap. Never machine wash or tumble dry. Dry flat or over a rounded form, away from direct sunlight.
